title: Japanese Basics 3
subtitle: Japanese Basics 3
courseType:
English Language Program
English Language Courses
educationalGoal: This course is a continuation of Japanese Basics 2 and aims to help students further develop the four basic communication skills—reading, writing, speaking, and listening—in modern Japanese. Students will learn fundamental grammatical structures and practice simple conversational skills, such as describing family members and expressing comparisons. The course will also introduce various aspects of Japanese culture, including sociolinguistic features that enhance effective communication. Six chapters (Lessons 7–12) will be covered.
advice: The class will be conducted using the following topics: Lesson 7 Family Picture Lesson 8 Barbecue Lesson 9 Kabuki Lesson 10 Winter Vacation Plans Lesson 11 After the Vacation Lesson 12 Feeling Ill
books: (A) Genki 1: An Integraded Course in Elementary Japanese, Third Edition (Eri Bando, et al., 2020) (B) Genki 1 Workbook (Eri Bando, et al., 2020), Third Edition
requiredKnowledge: This course is a continuation of Japanese Basics 2. Students should be familiar with the essential grammar and vocabulary covered in Lessons 1 to 6 (Genki 1).

activityGoals.body: For each topic, understand the meaning of important words and phrases and be able to use them correctly.
Have basic conversational skills, including describing family members and expressing comparisons.
Read and write the Japanese writing system (hiragana, katakana and kanji).

achievementLevels.ideal: - For each topic, understand the meaning of important words and phrases and be able to use them appropriately in context. - Understand fundamental grammatical structures and apply that knowledge appropriately in context. - Appropriately exhibit conversational skills for speech acts such as describing family members and expressing comparisons . - Accurately read and write the Japanese writing system (hiragana, katakana, and kanji). - Develop effective study skills.
achievementLevels.standard: - For each topic, understand the meaning of important words and phrases. - Understand fundamental grammatical structures. - Understand conversational skills necessary for speech acts such as describing family members and expressing comparisons . - Read and write the Japanese writing system (hiragana, katakana and kanji). - Understand effective study skills.
